messages:
Maya (Onboarding): Heads-up 1: I scheduled the New Hire Orientation for Mon 10/12 17:00 UTC but a couple of new hires pinged saying their calendar shows a different time and no Zoom passcode. Anyone seen this before? cc @calendar-bot

calendar-bot: Event created by Maya. ICS attached to event. Recording will be stored in /Onboarding/Recordings.

Ollie Chen: I noticed the invite came from a machine set to PDT so Google translated it oddly. In my Gmail it shows 10:00 PDT but my phone (UTC+2) showed 01:00 the next day.

Maya (Onboarding): oh no. Should I delete+recreate in UTC or update the existing event's timezone?

Samira Ortiz: Recreate in UTC is safest. Also copy the Zoom link AND the numeric passcode into the event description (some Outlook versions ignore the join link in preview). Add an explicit "Local times" mini-list for common zones (PST/CET/SGT/AEST).

Tom (IT): For Outlook desktop you sometimes need the TZID blocks in the ICS. If you're exporting an ICS from Google Calendar, check that it includes VTIMEZONE and TZID. Otherwise Outlook can shift times.

Ollie Chen: Another trick: publish the event and paste the "Add to calendar" links (Google/Outlook/Apple) in the Notion onboarding page. That avoids ICS export weirdness for some clients.

Maya (Onboarding): good tips. Plan: I'll recreate event set to UTC, paste Zoom URL and passcode in the description, add a short conversion list, attach the exported ICS with TZ blocks, and publish add-to-calendar links on Notion. I'll also mark it "Busy" so it blocks folks' calendars.

Samira Ortiz: Also: can we ensure the recording lives in Notion (embed) as well as Box? A couple of EMEA hires couldn't access Box last onboarding because of ACLs.

Tom (IT): I can pre-provision read access for the new-hires group to that Box folder. Send me the folder path after the session and I'll add the group.

Maya (Onboarding): will do. I'll post the new invite link + Notion page URL here once updated. ETA: EOD.

Ollie Chen: tiny nit: include an "APAC note" in the description: "If you're in APAC and the time falls overnight, DM Maya for a recording link and local ICS." We had someone show up at 3am once :grimacing:

calendar-bot: Tip: Use this command to create an event with explicit TZ via gcalcli: `gcalcli add --when "2026-10-12 17:00" --duration 75 --title "Redwood New Hire Orientation" --description "Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx Passcode: 987654" --calendar "Onboarding"` then export. Or via Google Calendar UI: More actions -> Publish event -> Add to calendar links.

Maya (Onboarding): thanks all. Updating now and will paste links here. If anyone still sees a timezone mismatch after I post the new ICS, reply with your OS/timezone and I'll hand-export an ICS for your zone.
